digest_resolution.note: The tag is floating, so this digest records what latest-nvidia-gpu WAS on this date. The host independently reported the same digest on pull, so the bytes served are the bytes named.

does_not_prove: That the weights baked into this image are Hugging Face revision c5630abae1d940eafe0697512a0325494b02ab42. The image was built 2026-05-28 and that revision was resolved 2026-09-05. Nothing here compares them, and `upstream_revision` on the registry row therefore still describes the weights the Arena measured rather than the weights this image serves.

Any accuracy figure. Four pages is a smoke test. The per-page output was not scored against ground truth, and the low-quality scan came back visibly degraded -- consistent with the campaign's published 36.9% low-quality-scan weakness, and not evidence about it.
